افترشوا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَشُوا (iftarašū) /if.ta.ra.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# اُفْتُرِشُوا (ufturišū) /uf.tu.ri.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# اِفْتَرِشُوا (iftarišū) /if.ta.ri.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
